C1283.title: Mass-Scale Theft of Online Short-Form Content Using Technical Means
C1283.summary: Starting in July 2024, suspect Mao self-taught programming and used technical methods to illegally scrape over 400,000 short-form articles from multiple legitimate content platforms, then built a piracy website with auto-update capabilities and profited by selling site access cards at low prices.
